decisions.statement: A reading lands on the rows beside the day page for the ESO day the reading began in.
Two readings naming the same span from the same source are one reading.
A reading already filed at that value is left untouched.
A reading whose value moved keeps the id and the seq that reading was filed under.
A reading landed carries the instant that reading arrived.
A write names the commit the rows were read at.
A write is refused where the rows file no longer has the rows read.
A reading is written through the pages rather than onto a checkout.
A write that cannot be kept is refused rather than answered as done.
Nothing here writes the day page the rows sit beside.
The rows written land as a commit.
A write the pages refuse is tried again from a fresh read.
Five tries are made at the most.
A change meant that named no commit is refused rather than answered as done.
A write that never landed throws.
A day committed is named as soon as that day's commit comes back.
A day that never landed says nothing about the days landed before it.
Nothing here states that nothing was committed.
A day whose readings were all filed already is answered without a commit.

definition: health readings landed on the day page for the ESO day each began in
